name: Chandler Worley Family Farms
tagline: Chandler Worley Family Farms — Apples in Cerro Gordo, NC
description: In Cerro Gordo, NC, Chandler Worley Family Farms raises Strawberries, Squash, and Tomatoes on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
